purpose: Teach: 取りまとめ/ファックス/激励/主査/次官/母体/個室/衣服

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトの意見の取りまとめを今日中にお願いね
lines.en: Could you pull together the project feedback by end of day?
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Light rising inflection on the question—delegating, not commanding. Quick tempo. Assumes competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方支社にはファックスでも報告致します
lines.en: Yes—I'll collect it and send a report to the regional offices by fax as well.
lines.style: Prompt, reassuring. Slight emphasis on 「fax」showing he's already planning ahead. Measured, professional. A nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人への激励のメッセージを書きましょう
lines.en: And let's write an encouragement message for the new hire.
lines.style: Warm shift in tone. Inclusive—「let's」, not command. Gentle opening, slightly slower than the first task. Personal concern beneath the business.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。主査クラスの定例会を準備します
lines.en: Understood—I'll get the regular managers' meeting set up.
lines.style: Steady, responsive. No hesitation. Professional but not stiff. The rhythm of someone keeping several plates spinning.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 元次官の講演会の招待状を発送しましょう
lines.en: We should send out invitations for the former vice minister's lecture.
lines.style: Slightly formal register—recognizing the importance of the event. Measured pace. Collaborative tone with 「we」. Clear but not hurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会社母体の組織図を更新します
lines.en: Yes—I'll also update the organizational chart for the parent company.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. Quick, organized. Shows he's tracking multiple threads. Professional and thorough. No strain in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 役員用の個室を予約しましょう
lines.en: Let's reserve the executive conference room.
lines.style: Direct but collaborative. Calm, efficient tempo. The tone of someone confident in execution. No flourish—just necessary.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員衣服のクリーニング契約を結びます
lines.en: Got it—I'll finalize the staff uniform cleaning contract.
lines.style: Closing note—slightly conclusive in tone. Affirming, organized. A touch of professional satisfaction. Clear and complete.
